source.name: AC Monza - I nostri sponsors / Partners page (Internet Archive capture)
source.note: On the club's own partners page, the logo under the 'SLEEVE SPONSOR' heading links to zeroplayer.it (AC Monza shop page). The club shop's product photo of the 2026/27 home shirt (https://shop.acmonza.com/maglia-uomo-nike-ac-monza-home-20262027) shows the 'ZeroPlayer by 3R Sport' wordmark on the sleeve, with DAZN Bet Club on the chest and no back or shorts sponsor. In 2025-26 ZeroPlayer sat on the front of the shirt (Calcio e Finanza, 2026-08-13), so the sleeve placement belongs to the 2026-27 kit. Live acmonza.com pages returned 404 to this check on 2026-10-03, so the Internet Archive capture is cited.

note: ZeroPlayer moved from a position on the front of the shirt (2025-26) to the sleeve for 2026-27. Contract start, length and value not disclosed; 'from' reflects the season in which the club documents the sleeve placement, not a stated contract date.
